metadata.scope: All 436 factual ISCO-08 unit-group codes and titles; original definition/duty prose is linked, not redistributed.
metadata.license: Factual classification codes and short titles only. Copyright International Labour Organization. The source predates the 2023 open-data policy; no CC BY licence is asserted for its definitions/duties.
metadata.attribution: International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08), International Labour Organization.
metadata.limitations: ISCO groups intentionally have no copied duty statements or automatic inheritance of all child ESCO skills. Forecasting must show category scope and classification-only coverage, or use a selected mapped ESCO role.
metadata.sha256Scope: roles serialized as UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators
